name: studio-kinds
description: The Studio — one editor for every document kind: the crosscut kit, the file-kind layer, the web Studio, the desktop app, the VS Code extension, the studio-check command, and the paste-and-check page.

scripts.desktop: pnpm --filter studio-frontend build:desktop && pnpm --filter studio-desktop start
scripts.vscode:vsix: pnpm --filter studio-frontend build:vscode && pnpm --filter studio-vscode package
scripts.desktop:dist: pnpm --filter studio-frontend build:desktop && pnpm --filter studio-desktop dist
scripts.release:build: pnpm vscode:vsix && pnpm desktop:dist && pnpm cli:pack
scripts.cli:pack: pnpm cli:build && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('apps/cli/out',{recursive:true})" && npm pack ./apps/cli --pack-destination apps/cli/out
